tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List all available video/audio processing tools with their options

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create a video/audio processing job. Use list_tools first to find the right tool and options. Returns a job ID — use get_job to check status and get the result URL. Needs a paid plan (Lite or higher). Non-AI results are included in the plan; AI results cost AI credits, charged when the result is rea

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check the status of a processing job. When status is 'completed', the response includes a download URL valid for 1 hour. An AI result's credits are charged once, when it's ready; if the balance is short the result stays locked and this returns an error saying what's needed — top up, then call get_jo

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. A cancelled job costs nothing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
